name: Real Madrid: Until the End
description: Step onto the field and go behind the scenes with the iconic soccer team for a look at their astonishing 2021–2022 season. Fueled by their fervent fans, they defy the odds and silence the skeptics.

videos.title: The Rebuild
videos.overview: After key players depart from the team, Carlo Ancelotti paves a new path forward and steadfast striker Karim Benzema steps into the spotlight.

videos.title: The Comeback
videos.overview: The team set out to defeat Paris Saint-Germain. Midfielder Luka Modrić reflects on his journey to greatness.

videos.title: Until the End
videos.overview: Pressures mount and emotions run high while facing Manchester City. In the aftermath, the team make a final push toward the ultimate trophy.
